text:
Alex P: handoff — I'm oncall until 02:00 UTC, handing primary to Mira S. Ongoing incident INC-4092 (kv-cache evictions in eu-west) still open, active alerts on eviction-rate and embedding failures. summary: impact on embeddings and some generation p99s.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-4092 triggered 3781231200 — assigned to Alex P (primary) · severity: page · status: acknowledged
Alex P: recent timeline — spike started ~20:38 UTC, eviction_rate jumped, automated prefetch throttles kicked in. We increased cache pool scaling +2 nodes at 20:50 UTC, but eviction rate stayed high.
Lina (oncall): observation — traffic pattern shows many short-lived prefix-heavy embedding requests from a customer test harness (acct: cust-881). Could be noisy tests.
Mira S: taking handoff. confirm primary/secondary? I can be primary now, Lina stays secondary, John on-call for infra escalation if we need manual scaling.
Alex P: yes — primary: Mira S, secondary: Lina (oncall), infra escalation: John R. Coverage gap: after 02:00 UTC we don't have an APAC-overnight secondary with perms to toggle reserved capacity. Note in playbook.
John R: acknowledged. I have access for reserved pools, but I'm on-call until 00:30 UTC then out. If we need rapid infra changes after that, escalate to oncall-lead.
Mira S: current mitigations in progress: 1) routing fraction to fallback model variant (quantized-medium) for embeddings 2) enforce per-tenant ephemeral rate limit for cust-881 3) rolling restart of cache-worker DaemonSet to clear fragmented mem (in progress)
Alex P: mitigation details — routing change applied at 21:05 UTC (10% -> 40% fallback). Per-tenant rate limit patch rolled out at 21:12 UTC. Restart of cache-workers started 21:20 UTC, 3/12 pods restarted so far.
Lina (oncall): metrics snapshot (21:28 UTC): eviction_rate=320/s, cache_miss_rate=18%, embeddings_5xx=0.9% (down from 2.6% at spike peak). latency_p99_embeddings=2.8s (was 6.1s).
Mira S: good improvement signal. still seeing tail. I plan to increase fallback to 70% if no further drop in eviction_rate in next 10m. Any objections?
Alex P: go ahead. Note: fallback increases may drop quality for a subset — inform CS if we hit >50% fallback sustained.
incident-bot: action logged: routing-fallback -> 40% applied by Alex P at 3781231500
Mira S: executing fallback increase to 70% now. CLI snippet: ```/runway route set --model embeddings-main --fallback embeddings-quant-med --fraction 0.7 --scope tenant=cust-881```
Mira S: done — applied at 21:31 UTC. Monitor feed shows embeddings_5xx -> 0.3% after 90s.
Lina (oncall): runbook pointers: KV Eviction Runbook https://redwood-internal.runbooks/kv-evictions — sections A (diagnose), B (soft mitigations), C (scale + stateful restart). Also see incident checklist: https://redwood-internal.runbooks/inc-checklist
John R: infra checks to consider if evictions don't subside: 1) bump reserved capacity for eu-west-cache (requires billing approval for burst) 2) reconfigure eviction policy to prioritize sticky keys 3) emergency compact + restart full pool (30–45m impact). I can start 1) now if needed.
Mira S: what's the current reserved capacity headroom?
Alex P: reserved pool at 80% pre-spike, we moved +2 nodes, now ~92% utilization. Headroom limited — need approval for burst (billing).
Mira S: accepted. I'll wait 10m post-fallback 70% to see trend. If eviction_rate >200/s after that, we call John to request burst.
Lina (oncall): customer impact notes for handoff: - cust-881: high volume test -> many errors, CS ticket #TKT-4435 open. - cust-1012: intermittent p99 regressions for chat completions from 21:00–21:20 UTC, some requests retried automatically. - All other customers: minor latency increases, no widespread failures.
Mira S: public-facing status suggestion: "Degraded performance for embeddings in EU-West; mitigations in progress. Some customers may see increased latency or transient errors." Keep short. I'll ping comms if we broaden.
Alex P: logs snippet from one restarted pod (21:22 UTC): ```I0215 21:22:03 eviction: triggered batch=420 rate=330/s free_mem=120Mi keys_evicted=104```
Mira S: action items for incoming shift: - monitor eviction_rate and embeddings_5xx dashboards - watch job restart progress (should finish by 21:50 UTC) - escalate to John if eviction_rate >200/s after 21:42 UTC - keep CS updated on cust-881 ticket - if fallback >50% sustained for 30m, coordinate quality regression postmortem.
Lina (oncall): I will own CS comms until 23:00 UTC, then hand to ops-cs. I'll post any customer notices in #support.
Mira S: I'm taking primary now. Ping me @Mira in thread for urgent calls. Leaving a quick checklist: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep cache-worker` ; `curl 'https://metrics/api?m=eviction_rate&region=eu-west'`.
Alex P: thanks, Mira. I'll remain reachable until 02:00 UTC if you need context.
Mira S: acknowledged — taking over. I'll post a short status update in 10m with metric trend.
incident-bot: INC-4092 status updated: acknowledged -> in_progress by Mira S at 3781231800
Alex P: handoff complete :thumbsup:
Mira S: handoff ack :white_check_mark: 
John R: standing by for infra escalation if requested.
Lina (oncall): noted and monitoring.
Mira S: end of thread — last check 21:41 UTC: eviction_rate=180/s, embeddings_5xx=0.25%, p99_embeddings=2.2s. continuing to watch.
